text: Ek sports academy mein boys aur girls ka ratio 7:4 hai. Agar 24 girls hain, toh academy mein total kitne bachche hain?
Ek gullak mein sirf ₹5 aur ₹10 ke sikke hain. Kul 30 sikke hain aur unki kul keemat ₹220 hai. ₹10 ke kitne sikke hain?
Kiran ek minute mein 45 shabd type karti hai. 1170 shabdon ka nibandh type karne mein use kitne minute lagenge?
Ek water purifier 4 minute mein 1.2 litre clean water deta hai. 1 ghante mein kitna clean water milega?
If you double the age of Ishaan's cousin and add 3 years, you get Ishaan's age. Ishaan 25 saal ka hai. Cousin ki umr kitni hai?
Ek fruit basket mein apples aur bananas ka ratio 3:7 hai. Agar 21 apples hain, toh kitne bananas honge?
Ek kaksha mein 40 vidyaarthi hain aur 15 bus se school aate hain. Bus se nahi aane waale vidyaarthiyon ka hissa bhinn mein bataaiye. Uttar sabse saral roop mein dijiye.
Ek taxi ₹14 per km charge karti hai aur ₹50 ki fixed fee bhi leti hai. 23 km ki ride ka fare kitna hoga?
Ajay ne school tak ke raaste ka 2/5 paidal tay kiya aur aakhri 1.8 km cycle se. School tak ka poora raasta kitne km ka hai?
Ishaan ke cousin ki umr ka dugna karke usmein 3 saal jodo, toh Ishaan ki umr milti hai. Ishaan 25 saal ka hai. Cousin ki umr kitni hai?
Riya ne ₹12 ki kuch pensilein aur ₹30 ki ek paani ki botal khareedi. Usne kul ₹126 kharch kiye. Riya ne kitni pensilein khareedi?
Mohit ek number sochta hai aur usme 23 add karta hai, toh result 61 aata hai. Mohit ne kaunsa number socha tha?
Ek rectangular garden ki length uski width se 6 m zyada hai aur uska perimeter 64 m hai. Garden ki width kitni hai?
Ajay ne school tak ke raaste ka 2/5 paidal tay kiya and cycled the remaining 1.8 km. School tak ka total distance kitne km hai?
Ek ladki cycle par har minute 250 m chalti hai. 4.5 km cover karne mein use kitne minute lagenge?
